name: OmniFlow Studio
description: Human-Agent Collaborative Visual Systems & Cloud Architecture Studio powered by W3C WebMCP
specification: W3C Web Model Context Protocol Draft 2026

tools.name: inspect_canvas_state
tools.description: Returns complete visual graph topology, CPU/memory telemetry, and live connection matrix

tools.name: create_node
tools.description: Instantiates infrastructure components (NVIDIA H100, Gateway, DB, Cache, Kafka, Auth)

tools.name: update_node
tools.description: Modifies node label, replica count, or hardware configuration

tools.name: delete_node
tools.description: Removes an architecture node and its connected links

tools.name: scale_node_replicas
tools.description: Scales horizontal replica count for containers or GPU clusters

tools.name: connect_nodes
tools.description: Creates network connections with protocol tagging (NVLink, gRPC, HTTPS, Redis TCP, Kafka)

tools.name: disconnect_nodes
tools.description: Removes a link between two architecture nodes

tools.name: batch_build_architecture
tools.description: Atomically constructs a multi-tier cloud topology in one transaction

tools.name: estimate_cloud_costs
tools.description: Calculates real-time FinOps monthly expenditure, hourly billing, and network egress costs

tools.name: optimize_cloud_costs
tools.description: Runs automated FinOps downscaling and spot optimizations (-38% cost)

tools.name: inject_ddos_attack
tools.description: Simulates 50,000 RPS DDoS flood to test gateway stress

tools.name: kill_random_node
tools.description: Chaos Monkey terminating a random service to test queue failover

tools.name: simulate_gpu_oom
tools.description: Simulates GPU Out-Of-Memory on NVIDIA H100 clusters

tools.name: auto_heal_cluster
tools.description: Recovers failed nodes, mitigates DDoS attacks, and defragments GPU VRAM

tools.name: simulate_traffic
tools.description: Starts 60 FPS animated particle simulation with dynamic RPS and latency percentiles

tools.name: stop_simulation
tools.description: Halts active traffic simulation

tools.name: run_security_audit
tools.description: Deep security audit for OWASP Top 10, SPOFs, and unauthenticated public database exposure

tools.name: optimize_architecture
tools.description: Applies automated refactoring for cost, latency, security, or high-availability

tools.name: generate_infrastructure_code
tools.description: Compiles Terraform, Kubernetes Helm, AWS CloudFormation, and Docker manifests

tools.name: generate_architecture_manifesto
tools.description: Compiles an executive Markdown manifesto with live Mermaid diagrams

tools.name: export_architecture_json
tools.description: Exports and downloads the active visual architecture as a standardized JSON blueprint

tools.name: import_architecture_json
tools.description: Imports and loads a custom architecture JSON definition onto the canvas

tools.name: apply_layout_preset
tools.description: Auto-arranges nodes using balanced hierarchical spacing

tools.name: load_architecture_template
tools.description: Loads enterprise blueprints (NVIDIA H100 AI Supercluster, Agent Swarm, E-Commerce, FinTech)

tools.name: export_canvas_image
tools.description: Downloads high-resolution PNG architecture diagram

tools.name: clear_canvas
tools.description: Resets and clears the visual canvas

tools.name: toggle_autonomous_autopilot
tools.description: Toggles 24/7 background self-healing auto-pilot loop

tools.name: benchmark_ai_models
tools.description: Evaluates Claude 3.7, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.0 Flash, and DeepSeek-R1 inference metrics

tools.name: simulate_global_geo_distribution
tools.description: Simulates Anycast Edge PoP cache hit ratios and regional latency SLAs across 4 continents

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalog of available cloud components, blueprints, and infrastructure modules

tools.name: quick_add_component
tools.description: HTML form tool for instant component creation

tools.name: trigger_quick_optimization
tools.description: HTML form tool for instant architecture optimization
